## v1.1.3 {% #v1-1-3 %}

Released 23 January 2020 · [GitHub release](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/releases/tag/v1.1.3)

Fixes small bug with console


## v1.1.2 {% #v1-1-2 %}

Released 23 January 2020 · [GitHub release](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/releases/tag/v1.1.2)

This is a bug fix release. We've added numerous typecasting additions to WOQL as well as allowing decoupling of the internal server URL from the URL used for presentation.


## v1.1.1 {% #v1-1-1 %}

Released 8 January 2020 · [GitHub release](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/releases/tag/v1.1.1)

This is a bug fix release. We've improved documentation, including the Docker installation instructions, and a quick-start application for Linux. Also improves error handling for remote csv loading, and fixes some errors in query processing.


## v1.1.0 {% #v1-1-0 %}

Released 7 January 2020 · [GitHub release](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/releases/tag/v1.1.0)

We are proud to release v1.1.0 of terminus-server, now with integration of terminus-store. This release expands our query offering as well as adding performance and scaling enhancements. We now have a much more sophisticated console that allows you to interactively query and build views of your results visually.


## v1.0.1 {% #v1-0-1 %}

Released 7 October 2019 · [GitHub release](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/releases/tag/v1.0.1)

A few minor bug fixes to v1.0.0 with changes to docker to simplify installation.

We hope that TerminusDB will make the life of anybody who cares about data — and particularly the long term value of well curated data — much easier.

The core team will be working on improving Terminus over the coming months, years and decades. We hope you’ll join us as a user, contributor or enthusiast. The database of the future needs you!


## v1.0.0 {% #v1-0-0 %}

Released 1 October 2019 · [GitHub release](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/releases/tag/v1.0.0)

The first version of terminus-server is released! 

The development of Terminus has been a nine-year labour of love, devotion, frustration and pain. You cannot imagine how delighted we are to release version 1.0.0

We hope that TerminusDB will make the life of anybody who cares about data — and particularly the long term value of well curated data — much easier.

The core team will be working on improving Terminus over the coming months, years and decades. We hope you’ll join us as a user, contributor or enthusiast. The database of the future needs you!
